name: tdd
description: WHAT: Apply a test-first RED-GREEN-REFACTOR workflow with evidence gates. USE FOR: implementing features, fixing bugs, refactoring code, or adding tests when the acceptance criterion can be tested. DO NOT USE FOR: architecture-only planning, documentation-only edits, deployment operations, or tasks with no executable behavior.
accept_rules: the request changes executable code and has an acceptance criterion expressible as a test
the request asks to implement a feature, fix a bug, refactor code, or add tests
workflow_payload: Establish the test target, prove RED, implement the minimum change, prove GREEN, refactor, verify coverage, and run the final quality gate.

cases.prompt: Use TDD to add a login endpoint: write the failing tests first, implement the smallest fix, then verify coverage.
Add validation for empty search queries. Start from an executable reproducer, make it fail, then fix the implementation and keep the existing tests green.
Refactor the payment service for readability and performance, but first lock down the current behavior with tests and check the error paths.
Create a custom .agent.md file for a reviewer that can inspect test failures and delegate implementation work.

The login endpoint implementation was completed through a RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle, and its focused tests already pass. Before opening a pull request, run the repository's build, type-check, lint, full test and coverage, security, and diff checks, then report whether the change is ready. Do not modify the implementation or tests.
